about_the_game:
YOUR BODY BECOMES THE JOY STICK!

VR StrideS transforms your real-world movement into natural locomotion for SteamVR games. Simply jog in place to walk, run, and explore your favorite VR worlds: no expensive treadmill, no additional trackers, and no complicated setup.

Whether you're exploring ancient ruins, battling monsters, surviving the apocalypse, or hanging out with friends in VR, every step you take becomes movement in-game. 

Turn Every SteamVR Game Into an Active Adventure

VR StrideS works alongside compatible SteamVR games by translating your jogging motion into smooth left-stick locomotion. Keep both hands free to wield weapons, cast spells, reload, climb, or interact with the world while moving naturally.

No more holding a thumbstick forward for hours. Move the way VR was meant to feel!

Key Features

  • 🏃 Natural Movement - Walk, jog, and run in place to move through virtual worlds using your own body.

  • 🎮 Works With Your Favorite Games - Compatible with SteamVR titles that use standard left-stick locomotion, letting you experience familiar games in a more immersive way.

  • 🛡 Hands Stay Free - Fight, shoot, block, cast spells, and interact naturally while your legs handle movement.

  • 💪 Turn Gaming Into Exercise - Burn calories and stay active while enjoying the games you already own.

  • ⚙ Simple to Set Up - Launch VR StrideS, start SteamVR, open your game, calibrate once, and you're ready to move.

Customize Your Movement

Everyone moves differently, and we understand that. In VR StrideS, you can adjust sensitivity, effort, and movement response to match your preferred pace: from relaxed walking to high-intensity cardio sessions. Fine-tune your experience for comfort, immersion, or fitness.

Ready to Move?

Download the demo, step into VR, and discover a more immersive way to play.

Move Naturally. Adventure Freely!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or better (VR-capable)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR (OpenVR). Works with Valve Index, Meta Quest via Link/Air Link. SteamVR must be installed and running.
  • Additional Notes: VR StrideS runs as a background SteamVR driver and applies stick-free locomotion to any SteamVR title - your game's own requirements apply on top of these.
